blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Frontier models, general-purpose and domain-specific alike, now include a midtraining stage between pretraining and post-training, but little has been published about how this stage is built. We present an open midtraining recipe that primes base models for agentic post-training, and we show its effectiveness on two Nemotron models of different sizes. Pretraining typically runs at short context and sees almost no agent interactions, while SFT data is mostly synthetic, and very long SFT stages can hurt the model's later RL trainability. Our midtraining stage sits between the two. It trains at 256K context for hundreds of billions of tokens on a diverse mixture of natural software-engineering data like packed repositories, pull requests, commit histories, and build logs together with a small share of agentic traces. On Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, 500B midtraining tokens improve SWE-bench Verified from 60.7 to 64.5, SWE-bench Multilingual from 55.8 to 62.8, and SWE-bench Pro from 32.0 to 35.5 after identical full SFT. On the larger Nemotron 3.5 Super, 280B midtraining tokens improve DeepSWE, a harder benchmark of long-horizon tasks, from 11.7 to 15.7 and SWE-bench Verified from 72.9 to 74.3 after identical full SFT. Midtraining also improves robustness across agent harnesses on both models. We report the ablations behind the recipe and an evaluation protocol built on short fixed SFT runs, since base-model proxy metrics did not correlate reliably with post-training results.
blocks.zh: 边疆模式,无论是通用模式还是特定领域模式,现在都包括培训前培训与培训后培训之间的中期培训阶段,但对这一阶段的建设方式几乎没有发表。 我们提出了一种开放式的中期训练方法,它为动力后训练的基础模型提供素材,我们在两种不同大小的尼莫特龙模型上显示出它的功效. Pretrain通常在短上下文中运行,几乎看不到代理交互,而SFT数据大多是合成的,而非常长的SFT相位会伤害模型后期的RL列车可操作性. 我们的中场训练阶段位于两者之间。 它以256K为背景,在诸如被包装的存储器,拉取请求,承诺历史,以及少量的代理痕迹等多种软件-工程数据组合上,对上千亿令牌进行训练. 在Nemotron 3.5闪电上,500B的中训活符改进了SWE-bench验证从60.7到64.5,SWE-bench多种语言从55.8到62.8,SWE-bench Pro经过完全相同的SFT后从32.0到35.5. 在更大的Nemotron 3.5 Super上,280B的中训符号改进了DeepSWE,这是长视任务较硬的基准,从11.7到15.7,SWE-bench在完全相同的SFT后验证从72.9到74.3. 中期培训还改进了对两种模式的利用。 我们报告食谱背后的裂痕和建立在SFT短短固定运行基础上的评价协议,因为基模代用计量标准与培训后结果不可靠。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Between pretraining and post-training, frontier coding models such as Qwen3-Coder-Next ( Cao et al., 2026 ) , GLM-5 ( GLM-5 Team, 2026 ) , Kimi-Dev ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and Composer 2 ( Cursor Research, 2026 ) include a midtraining stage of hundreds of billions of tokens of agentic, long-context data on top of a converged base model. Technical reports describe this stage at a high level, but rarely explain how its data is constructed, filtered, and weighted, or measure the impact of each design choice. Following Qwen-Coder ( Hui et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) , we present an open midtraining recipe for agentic coding, developed and demonstrated on Nemotron base models. We describe how each data source is built, and we report the ablations that guided our training choices.
blocks.zh: 在训练前与训练后之间,边疆编码模型如Quen3-Coder-Next(Cao等人,2026年),GLM-5(GLM-5 Team,2026年),Kimi-Dev(杨等人,2026年),以及编曲. 2 (Cursor Research, 2026)包括一个中训阶段,在一个聚合基模型之上,有上千亿令牌,长文本数据. 技术报告在高层次上描述了这一阶段,但很少解释其数据是如何构建、过滤和加权的,或衡量每个设计选择的影响。 继Quen-Coder(Hui等人,2024年;Cao等人,2026年)之后,我们提出了一种用于代理编码的开放式中试食谱,在Nemotron碱基模型上开发并演示. 我们描述了每个数据来源是如何构建的,我们报告了指导我们培训选择的谎言。

blocks.en: Base models are usually pretrained at short sequence lengths, typically 4K to 8K tokens for compute efficiency ( DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ; Qwen Team, 2025 ) , and then extended to long context in a short final stage before SFT. Nemotron models, for example, are pretrained at 8K and extended to 1M. The data that matters most for software-engineering agents does not fit this pipeline. Pretraining corpora usually contain almost no agent interactions, as in the Nemotron pretraining corpus ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) , and the natural data around software engineering, such as whole repositories, code evolution through commit histories, pull requests, and build logs, often runs to tens or hundreds of thousands of tokens, too long for pretraining and too large for a short long-context stage. Adding agent traces to pretraining is also not straightforward, since pretraining typically applies no loss masking, and it is unclear how the tool responses (environment outputs) in those traces should be handled. SFT in turn consists mostly of synthetic chat data. Recent work has documented that very long SFT stages can reduce how much the model later gains from RL ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and we have observed this in our own training as well.
blocks.zh: 基础模型通常在短序列长度前进行预训,一般为4K至8K令牌进行计算效率(DeepSeek-AI,2024;Quen Team,2025),然后在SFT前的短最后阶段延伸至长背景. 例如,Nemotron模型在8K被预先训练,并延长至1M. 软件工程代理商最重要的数据并不符合这一管道。 Pretraining Corpora通常不包含任何代理相互作用,如Nemotron预训程序(NVIDIA,2025年),以及软件工程周围的自然数据,如整个寄存器,通过承诺历史的代码演化,拉请求,以及建立日志,通常运行到数万或数十万个令牌,对于预训时间太长,对于短长的编译阶段来说太大. 在预训中添加剂痕量也不是直截了当的,因为预训通常不采用损失掩码,而且不清楚如何处理这些痕量中的工具反应(环境产出)。 SFT又主要由合成聊天数据组成. 最近的工作证明,非常长的SFT阶段可以减少该模型后来从RL(Liu等人,2026b;Kang等人,2025;Zhang等人,2026)中获得的收益,我们在自己的培训中也观察到这一点。

blocks.en: Midtraining fills this gap. Before the final long-context stage, it trains for hundreds of billions of tokens at 256K, long enough to hold whole repositories, commit histories, and long agent traces (§ 5.1 ). The data is mostly natural software-engineering data, with a bounded share of agent traces whose tool responses are masked from the loss. Much of this learning can therefore move out of SFT, so SFT can stay short and preserve the model’s later RL trainability ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 中级培训填补了这一空白。 在最后的长篇小说阶段之前,它以256K的速度进行数千亿令牌的训练,足够长的时间来保存整个储存库,承担历史,以及长的代理痕迹(第5.1节). 数据大多是天然软件工程数据,有一定比例的代理跟踪,其工具响应被丢失掩盖. 因此,这种学习大多可以搬出SFT,因此SFT可以保持较短的距离,并保存模型后来的RL可操作性(Liu等人,2026b;Kang等人,2025;Zhang等人,2026).

blocks.en: We develop the recipe on Nemotron 3.5 Lightning-30B-A3B and then scale it to the larger Nemotron 3.5 Super-120B-A12B ( NVIDIA, 2026a ) . On N-3.5 Lightning, 500B midtraining tokens improve SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Pro by 3.8, 7.0, and 3.5 points over the same model without midtraining after identical full SFT, with the most sustained gains on SWE-bench Multilingual (§ 4.3 ). On N-3.5 Super, 280B midtraining tokens improve DeepSWE from 11.7 to 15.7 and SWE-bench Verified from 72.9 to 74.3 after identical full SFT (§ 4.4 ). Midtraining also improves robustness to the agent harness, which matters for open models that are used with many different harnesses. Both models improve on every harness we tested, and on N-3.5 Super after 65B tokens and short SFT, the average gain across harnesses is 8.6 points on SWE-bench Verified and 6.8 on Terminal-Bench (§ 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们开发了尼莫特龙3.5闪电-30B-A3B的配方,然后将其放大到更大的尼莫特龙3.5 Super-120B-A12B(NVIDIA,2026a ) 。 在N-3.5闪电上,500B的中训标志将SWE-bench验证,多语言,Pro改进3.8,7.0和3.5分,在SFT完全相同后不进行中训,在SWE-bench多语言上获得了最持久的收益(§4.3 ). 在N-3.5 Super上,280B的中训标志将DeepSWE从11.7改进为15.7,SWE-bench在完全相同的SFT(§4.4)后进行验证从72.9改进为74.3. 中训也提高了剂电机的稳健性,这对许多不同电机使用的开放型号至关重要。 这两个模型改进了我们测试的每条绳索,在65B令牌和短SFT之后的N-3.5 Super,整个绳索的平均收益在SWE-bench验证器上为8.6分,在终端-Bench上为6.8分(第4.5节)。

blocks.en: We make the following contributions. • A fully documented midtraining data recipe, showing that a small share of agentic traces adds clear gains on top of natural data (§ 3 and § 4.2 ). • An evaluation protocol based on identical SFT runs, since base-model proxy metrics such as bits-per-byte and LoCoDiff did not reliably predict post-training results (§ 4.1 ). • We show that gains hold as we scale both model size and midtraining tokens up to 500B, across benchmarks and agent harnesses (§ 4 ). • Ablations of modeling choices, such as the learning rate, the share of replayed pretraining data, tool-response masking, and midtraining’s effect on long-context ability (§ 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们作出以下贡献。 • 支助 一份充分记录的中级培训数据配方,显示少量的代理痕迹在自然数据之上增加了明显的收益(§3和§4.2)。 以相同的SFT为基础的评价协议运行,因为基模代用计量标准,如比特/字节和LoCoDiff,无法可靠地预测培训后的结果(第4.1节)。 我们显示,当我们把模型大小和中级训练标志扩大至500B时,在基准和代理工具之间,收益是有限的(第4节)。 · 模型选择的缺失,如学习率、重播的预培训数据份额、工具反应遮掩以及中培训对长写能力的影响(第5节)。

blocks.en: A fully documented midtraining data recipe, showing that a small share of agentic traces adds clear gains on top of natural data (§ 3 and § 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 一份充分记录的中级培训数据配方表明,少量的代理痕迹在自然数据之上增加了明显的收益(§3和§4.2)。

blocks.zh: 我们显示,当我们把模型大小和中级训练标志扩大至500B时,在基准和代理工具之间,收益是有限的(第4节)。

blocks.en: Ablations of modeling choices, such as the learning rate, the share of replayed pretraining data, tool-response masking, and midtraining’s effect on long-context ability (§ 5 ).
blocks.zh: 模型选择的缺失,如学习率、重播的预训练数据份额、工具反应遮掩以及中训对长写能力的影响(第5节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Although midtraining is growing in popularity, only a few works have presented detailed recipes and ablation results to the community. Qwen3-Coder-Next provides one such recipe, midtraining at a 256K context on trillions of tokens, including 600B tokens of repository-level data across 370 programming languages ( Cao et al., 2026 ) . Its recipe suggests combining mined PR data with agentic traces but does not explain exactly how to do so. GLM-5 reports midtraining on approximately 1.55T tokens with progressive context extension, including 160B tokens of software-engineering data constructed from roughly 10M issue–PR pairs ( GLM-5 Team, 2026 ) , but does not provide details of the recipe. Kimi-Dev, one of the primary works on which we build, provides a more detailed recipe ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . It performs midtraining on approximately 150B tokens of diff patches, commit sequences, and synthetic agent interactions, and shows that a model with this prior needs far fewer SFT tokens than the raw base model to reach the same agent performance. daVinci-Dev advocates trajectory-style midtraining data and matches Kimi-Dev’s performance using fewer than half as many tokens ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) . Composer 2 shows that code-focused continued pretraining improves downstream RLVR performance ( Cursor Research, 2026 ) . AgentFounder similarly shows that continued pretraining benefits search agents ( Su et al., 2026 ) , while Liu et al. (2026a) study when midtraining effectively bridges the distributions of pretraining and post-training data. Relative to these works, we provide the ablation-level detail missing from the technical reports and evidence that the gains persist through full SFT.
blocks.zh: 虽然中级培训越来越受欢迎,但只有少数作品向社区提出了详细的食谱和消化结果。 Qune3-Coder-Next提供了一种这样的配方,在256K上下文中对万亿令牌进行中期培训,包括370种编程语言的600B级寄存器级数据(Cao等人,2026年). 其配方建议将已开采的PR数据与剂痕量相结合,但没有确切解释如何这样做。 GLM-5报告了大约1.55T标志的中期培训,并逐步扩展了上下文,包括160B标志的软件工程数据,数据由大约10M期的PR配对(GLM-5 Team,2026)构建而成,但没有提供配方的细节. 纪美... 德夫是我们赖以建构的主要作品之一,提供了更详细的食谱(杨等人,2026年). 它对大约150B个代号的diff补丁进行中试,承诺序列,以及合成剂相互作用,并显示具有这种先前需要的模型比原始基号要少得多SFT代号才能达到相同的代号性能. daVinci-Dev提倡轨迹式的中训数据, 作曲者2显示,以代码为重点的持续预训改善了下游的RLVR性能(Cursor Research, 2026). AgentFounder同样表明,持续的培训前福利搜索代理(Su等人,2026年),而Liu等人(2026年a)则在培训中期有效沟通培训前和培训后数据的分发时进行研究。 与这些作品相比,我们提供了技术报告所缺少的减缩层面的细节,并提供了证明这些成果通过全面的SFT而持续存在的证据。

blocks.en: StarCoder2 concatenates repository files in random order ( Lozhkov et al., 2024 ) ; DeepSeek-Coder orders files by import dependencies ( Guo et al., 2024 ) ; SPLiCe shows that structured packing improves long-context use ( Staniszewski et al., 2025 ) ; ProLong randomizes on purpose to avoid recency bias ( Gao et al., 2025 ) . Sapronov & Glukhov (2025) find that most of the gain from repository-level pretraining for project-level code completion comes from adapting to a longer context rather than from how the repository context is assembled. Best-Fit Packing reduces truncation harms ( Ding et al., 2024 ) , and In-Context Pretraining shows related-document packing helps beyond code ( Shi et al., 2024 ) . Our repository data differs in selection . We keep only repositories whose files reference each other through imports, and order files so that related code is adjacent (§ 3 ).
blocks.zh: StarCoder2按随机顺序整理寄存器文件(Lozhkov等人,2024年);DeepSeek-Coder按导入依赖性订购文件(Guo等人,2024年);SPLiCe显示结构化包装改善了长文本使用(Staniszewski等人,2025年);ProLong按意随机排列,以避免重任偏差(Gao等人,2025年). Sapronov & Glukhov(2025年)发现,用于项目级代码完成的寄存器级预训的大部分收益来自适应更长的上下文,而不是寄存器级如何组装. Best-Fit Packing可减少切变伤害(Ding等人,2024年),In-Context Pretrain显示相关文件包装帮助超出代码(Shi等人,2024年). 我们的存储器数据在选择上有所不同。 我们只保存通过导入相互参考文件的存储器,并订购文件,以便相关代码相邻(§ 3).

blocks.en: Agentic benchmarks are unreliable before post-training, so Composer 2 selects among base models using held-out codebase perplexity, state tracking, and adversarially built QA instead ( Cursor Research, 2026 ) . Other benchmarks target specific skills. LoCoDiff measures file-state reconstruction from git history ( Mentat AI Team (2025), AbanteAI ) , RepoBench and CrossCodeEval measure cross-file completion ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Ding et al., 2023 ) , and APTBench converts agent tasks into a format base models can answer ( Qin et al., 2025 ) . Whether such base-model measures predict downstream ability is still contested ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . In our experiments, they did not track post-training results reliably (§ 4.1 ).
blocks.zh: 代理基准在训练后不可靠,因此作曲家2在基础模型中选择使用被搁置的代码库杂乱性,状态跟踪,以及对抗性构建的QA(Cursor Research, 2026). 其他基准针对特定技能。 LoCoDiff测量从git历史(Mentat AI Team (2025), AbanteAI),Repo Bench和CrossCodeEval测量跨文件完成(Liu等人,2024;Ding等人,2023),APT Bench将代理任务转换为格式基础模型可以回答(Qin等人,2025). 此类基准模型措施是否预测下游的能力仍然有争议(Liu等人,2023年;Chen等人,2025年)。 在我们的实验中,他们没有可靠地跟踪培训后的结果(第4.1节)。

blocks.en: 3 The Midtraining Recipe
blocks.zh: 3 中训食谱

blocks.zh: 图 1: 中级培训混合体,按培训标志份额分列。 重播取自基础模型的预训数据. 表1列出了每个来源的数据和时代。

blocks.zh: 表1:图1中培训组合的来源 重播取材自基底模型的最后阶段预训混合. Epochs是用独特的符号来分割的标志.

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the blend, which is designed for diversity. Most of it is natural software-engineering data, with a small share of synthetic agent traces. We render these traces in the Nemotron chat template and keep them to 10–15% of the blend to avoid overfitting to SFT-like data, which can hurt later RL trainability ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Everything else stays in natural formats, without chat templates. Every source keeps only permissive licenses and goes through decontamination against SWE-bench and Terminal-Bench, secret redaction, and loss masking of content the model should not imitate, such as repeated delimiters, hashes, and timestamps.
blocks.zh: 图1概括了为多样性设计的混合体。 大部分是天然软件工程数据,其中合成剂痕迹的比重很小. 在Nemotron聊天模板中,我们将这些痕迹制成10-15%的混合数据,以避免与类似SFT的数据过于吻合,这可能会损害以后的RL可操作性(Liu等人,2026b;Kang等人,2025;Zhang等人,2026)。 其他一切都保持自然格式,没有聊天模板. 每个来源都只保留许可,对SWE-bench和Terminal-Bench进行消毒、秘密编辑和内容损失掩码,例如重复的划界器、散列器和时间戳。

blocks.en: We construct a large-scale code-change corpus from merged pull requests in public GitHub repositories, combining repository snapshots with PR descriptions, linked issues, review discussions, and observed patch evolution when available. We restrict collection to repositories with at least ten stars in supported programming languages. We deduplicate examples by repository and PR identifier and remove records with unavailable repositories, missing Git objects, failed patch reconstruction, empty or excessively large changes, generated content, or other low-quality patches. Each example is laid out as a sequence in which repository metadata, date, file tree, and code context condition the model’s reconstruction of the submitted changes. No chat template is applied to this data, but we mask repetitive formatting text from the training loss. In total, this process leaves us with 12.1 million PRs and 200 billion to 2 trillion tokens depending on how much repository context we include in each example. For issue-linked PRs, a structured LLM judge additionally checks that the issue and the patch match, and PR-only examples are filtered with deterministic rules (Appendix A.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们从公共 GitHub 寄存器的拉动请求中构建一个大规模代码更改程序, 将寄存器快照与PR描述, 关联问题, 审查讨论, 我们把收藏限制在拥有至少十颗恒星的存储库中,使用支持的编程语言. 我们通过寄存器和 PR 标识符复制实例,并删除没有寄存器的记录,丢失 Git 对象,失败的补丁重建,空或过大的更改,生成的内容,或其他低质量的补丁. 每个例子都作为寄存器元数据、日期、文件树和代码上下文的顺序列出,以作为模型重建所提交的更改的条件。 本数据没有应用聊天模板,但我们掩盖了训练丢失的重复格式化文本. 整个过程给我们留下了1210万个公关和2 000亿到2万亿个信使,这取决于我们在每个例子中包含多少寄存物。 对于与问题挂钩的公关,一个结构化的LLM判断员额外检查该问题和补丁匹配,以及仅限公关的例子被过滤出定断规则(Appendix A.1 ).

blocks.en: Pretraining corpora have historically presented code as individual files rather than whole repositories, and even when files from one repository are packed together, a short pretraining context holds only a small part of it. Agents, however, work inside repositories far longer than that and must use code defined far from where it is called. Midtraining is where the model first reads whole repositories and predicts code that depends on files tens of thousands of tokens earlier. This helps most when the files actually depend on each other, and in many repositories they do not, since many are collections of scripts, exercises, or snippets that never import one another. We start from the repositories in the Nemotron 3 pretraining corpus ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) , build an import graph for every repository in 14 languages, and keep only repositories in which at least 20% of code files have an import edge to another file in the repository (10% for Ruby). Kept repositories are serialized with the top-level README first and connected files next to each other, and packed at 256K, with longer repositories split between connected components rather than truncated, giving about 104B tokens. Compared to alphabetical ordering, dependency ordering better separates stronger from weaker models. It lowers bits-per-byte for stronger models and raises it for weaker ones, which suggests that it exposes cross-file structure that weaker models have not yet learned. The languages, filters, and blend weights are listed in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: Pretraining Corpora在历史上以单个文件而不是整个寄存器的形式呈现代码,即使一个寄存器的文件被打包在一起,一个简短的预训背景也只持有一小部分. 然而,代理人在储存库内工作的时间远远长于这一时间,必须使用远离其名称的编码。 Midtraining是该模型最早读取整个寄存器的地方,并预测了依赖于更早的数万个令牌文件的代码. 这在文件实际上互相依赖时最有帮助,在许多寄存器中,它们并不如此,因为许多文件都是从不互相导入的脚本、练习或片段的集合。 我们从Nemotron 3 预训集(NVIDIA, 2025)的寄存器开始, 用14种语言为每个寄存器建立导入图, 并且只保留至少20%的代码文件对寄存器中另一个文件有导入边缘的寄存器(Ruby为10%) 。 Kept寄存器首先与顶级的README和相邻的连接文件进行序列化,包装为256K,较长的寄存器在连接的组件之间分割而不是切换,给出了大约104B个令牌. 与字母顺序相比,依附顺序更能将较弱的模型区分开来. 它降低比特/比特对于更强模型的比特,提高对于更弱模型的比特,这说明它暴露了较弱模型尚未学到的跨文件结构. 语言、过滤器和混合重量列于附录A.2。

blocks.en: Much of software engineering is changing existing code, such as making an edit that stays consistent across several files or keeping track of what a file looks like after a long series of changes. Repository snapshots only show code in its final state, so we build two kinds of examples from commit histories. Multi-file edits take a merged pull request, show the model the affected files before the change, and train it to produce them after the change. We keep only changes whose files are linked in the import graph used for the repository data, so that the edits are coupled. Code-evolution documents give the initial state of a file, the sequence of real commits that changed it from oldest to newest, and its final state. This trains the long-range state tracking that LoCoDiff measures ( Mentat AI Team (2025), AbanteAI ) . Histories range from a single commit to several dozen. Diff headers, commit hashes, authors, and dates are masked from the loss. Sources, filters, and statistics are in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 许多软件工程正在改变已有的代码,比如在多个文件之间保持一致的编辑,或者跟踪一个文件在经过长时间的一系列修改之后的长相. 仓库快照仅显示其最终状态的代码,所以我们从承诺历史中构建了两种例子. 多文件编辑会接受合并的拉动请求,在更改前显示受影响的文件模型,并在更改后对其进行制作培训. 我们只保留其文件链接在寄存器数据导入图中的更改,以便编辑组合 。 代码进化文件给出了文件的初始状态,将文件从最古老到最新的真实承诺的序列,以及最终状态. 这训练了LoCoDiff措施(Mentat AI Team (2025), AbanteAI)的远程状态跟踪. 历史从一个承诺到几十个。 Diff头, 执行散列,作者, 和日期被蒙蔽 丢失。 资料来源、过滤器和统计数据见附录A.3。

blocks.en: Agents constantly read logs, stack traces, and build output, but PR data lacks the environment’s response, so we add raw system logs from the full LogHub archives ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) and CI/CD logs from GitHub Actions run logs and workflow-file histories ( Moriconi et al., 2025 ; Cardoen et al., 2024 ) , plus a small curated slice pairing log windows with diagnoses (Appendix A.4 ).
blocks.zh: GitHub Actions的CI/CD日志运行日志和工作流程文件历史(Moriconi等人,2025年;Cardoen等人,2024年),外加一个小的配对日志窗口(Appendix A.4)。

blocks.en: The corpus used in our blend contains about 39B tokens (over one million trajectories, about 500K distinct queries, and 30M tool calls, including SWE-Zero and SWE-Hero trajectories ( Ludwig et al., 2026 ) ). A small portion of the agentic midtraining blend consists of data contributed by Perplexity as a partner in the Nemotron Coalition. The full trace corpus covers more than ten agent scaffolds, including OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , OpenCode, SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , Codex, Claude Code, and Terminus, across software engineering, terminal use, search, and general tool use, because traces from a single scaffold transfer poorly to others ( Cao et al., 2026 ) . Each trajectory keeps its scaffold’s instructions and tool definitions and is rendered in the Nemotron chat template. Appendix A.5 gives the statistics and distributions.

blocks.en: 3.1 Training
blocks.zh: 3.1 培训

blocks.en: Midtraining starts from a converged base model, so we choose the training setup to add new capabilities without degrading what the base model already knows. We train at 256K context, long enough to hold almost every midtraining document, many of which are far longer than the 8K pretraining context (Figure 2 ). Our first N-3.5 Lightning experiments start from the 8K pretraining checkpoint, N-3.5 Lightning-8K. For the N-3.5 Lightning scaling run and all N-3.5 Super runs, we start from the 1M long-context checkpoint, which lets us go straight from midtraining to SFT, keeping evaluations simple. In a mature pipeline, midtraining would come before the final long-context stage (§ 5.1 ). We set the replay share to 20% (§ 5.3 ). The learning rate warms up briefly and then stays constant, at 5e-5 for N-3.5 Lightning, which favors agentic gains, and 1e-5 for the larger N-3.5 Super, which favors preserving general capabilities (§ 5.3 ). Appendix B lists the full settings.
blocks.zh: 中训从一个聚合的基模型开始,所以我们选择培训设置来增加新的能力,而不贬低基模型已经知道的. 我们的训练时间为256K背景,足够长,几乎可以持有每份中途训练文件,其中许多文件比8K预训背景(图2)要长得多. 我们的第一个N3.5闪电实验是从8K预训检查站N3.5闪电-8K开始. 对于N-3.5闪电缩放运行和所有N-3.5Super运行,我们从1M长文本检查点开始,这让我们从训练中直接到SFT,保持评价的简单. 在成熟的管道中,中期培训将在最后长文阶段之前进行(第5.1节)。 我们把重播份额设定为20%(第5.3节)。 学习速度短暂地变暖,然后保持不变,N-3.5闪电为5e-5,这有利于代理收益,而N-3.5超级大号为1e-5,这有利于保持一般能力(第5.3节)。 附 录 B 列出全部设置 。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价协议

blocks.en: The success of midtraining is ultimately measured by how well the model does after post-training. Our evaluation protocol is therefore holistic. It runs the full post-training pipeline and also tracks base-model post-trainability metrics and pretraining general-capability benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 中训成功与否,最终以该模式在培训后的表现如何来衡量。 因此,我们的评价程序是全面的。 它运行完整的培训后管道,并跟踪培训后基准模型和培训前一般能力基准。

blocks.en: • Short and full SFT. We use an agentic-focused SFT blend (Appendix B.1 ) at two budgets, 33B tokens (short SFT) and 100B tokens (full SFT), and compare each midtrained model with its starting checkpoint after identical SFT. Full SFT was close to saturation in our runs and supports the main claims, while short SFT gives a quicker signal. • Fixed evaluations. We evaluate on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Pro, DeepSWE, Terminal-Bench (version 2.0, or 2.1 where noted), and a BrowseComp subset. Unless stated otherwise, SWE-bench runs in OpenHands and Terminal-Bench in Terminus-2, with pass@1 averaged over 3 and 8 rollouts per task (Appendix C.1 gives the setup and references). We also report pass@ k k , since a higher pass@ k k has been shown to indicate more room for RL to improve ( Yue et al., 2025 ) . • Base-model post-trainability metrics. LoCoDiff ( Mentat AI Team (2025), AbanteAI ) , RepoBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , and bits-per-byte on held-out code repositories and on agent traces (Appendix C.2 ) measure capabilities that midtraining targets, such as file-state tracking and cross-file modeling. For traces we score the decisive turns of DeepSWE trajectories ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , which correlated best with post-training results. LoCoDiff is averaged over 3 greedy runs on all 198 cases, and the other metrics are single runs. They improve with midtraining (Table 5 ), but did not track post-training results closely enough to guide recipe decisions. • Regression checks. During midtraining we also track the pretraining general-capability benchmarks from NVIDIA (2026b) in four groups, general knowledge, math, code, and commonsense understanding (Appendix C.1 ), to catch regressions (§ 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: • 短而完整的SFT。 我们使用一种以特效为重点的SFT混合(Appendix B.1)在两个预算,33B令牌(短SFT)和100B令牌(全SFT),并在完全相同的SFT之后,将每个中试型号与其起始检查站进行比较. 全SFT在我们运行中接近饱和度,支持主要主张,而短SFT给出了更快的信号. • 固定评价。 我们通过SWE-bench验证、多种语言和Pro、DeepSWE、Terminal-Bench(2.0版或2.1版,请注明)以及浏览Comp子集进行评估。 除非另有说明,SWE-bench在OpenHands和Terminus-2的Terminus-Bench运行,每个任务平均通过@1超过3次和8次(附录C.1给出了设置和参考). 我们还报告通过@kkk,因为已显示通过较高的@kkk表明,RL有更大的改进空间(Yue等人,2025年)。 LoCoDiff (Mentat AI Team (2025), AbanteAI ), Repo Bench (Liu et al., 2024)),以及被扣代码寄存器和代理痕迹上的比特/比特(Appendix C.2 )测量中训练目标的能力,如文件状态跟踪和交叉文件模型. 关于痕迹,我们得分是DeepSWE轨迹的决定性转折(Yu等人,2026年),这些转折与培训后的结果最为相关。 LoCoDiff平均在全部198个病例上3个以上贪婪的跑步,其他的衡量标准是单跑. 它们通过中级培训有所改进(表5),但没有充分跟踪培训后的结果,以指导食谱决定。 • 退缩检查。 在中训期间,我们还跟踪NVIDIA(2026b)的预训一般能力基准,分为四组:一般知识、数学、代码和常识理解(附录C.1),以抓住倒退(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: 4.2 Blend validation on N-3.5 Lightning
blocks.zh: 4.2 N-3.5闪电上的混合验证

blocks.en: Table 2: Early experiment on the N-3.5 Lightning-8K checkpoint, midtrained for 100B tokens with and without agentic traces and compared with the base model after identical short or full SFT (%).
blocks.zh: 表2:在N-3.5闪电-8K检查站的早期实验,100B令牌的中试,有和无代理痕迹,在经过相同的短或全SFT后与基型相比(%).

blocks.en: Our first experiment midtrains the N-3.5 Lightning-8K base model for 100B tokens, once on the full blend and once without agentic traces, and compares both with the base model after identical SFT (Table 2 ). Gains seen after short SFT carry over to full SFT, so short SFT can serve as a quick check. Midtraining improves SWE-bench Verified and Multilingual pass@1 by 0.8 and 8.2 points after short SFT, and both gains remain after full SFT (3.8 and 3.7 points). Terminal-Bench is noisier and improves only in full-SFT pass@1. Agentic traces give the majority of the gain after SFT. The no-traces model, trained on natural data alone, gains less than one point on SWE-bench Verified after full SFT, while the full blend improves on it by 3.0, 2.5, and 6.6 points on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual, and Terminal-Bench. We still keep natural data as the large majority of the blend. Its benefits show up beyond SWE-bench pass@1, in file-state tracking and cross-file modeling (Tables 5 and 5 ) and robustness across agent harnesses (§ 4.5 ), and a blend of mostly traces would amount to a much longer SFT, which can hurt later RL trainability ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的首次实验对100B令牌的N-3.5闪电-8K基型进行中试,一次在完全混合上,一次没有剂痕,并在SFT完全相同后与基型进行比较(表2). 短SFT后看到的收益结转到全SFT,因此短SFT可以作为快速检查. 中训在短SFT后将SWE-bench验证和多语种传球@1改进0.8分和8.2分,在全SFT(3.8分和3.7分)后两者的得分均保留. 终端-奔驰是噪声,只在全SFT通行@1. 代理痕迹在SFT之后获得了大部分收益. 仅接受自然数据培训的无轨电车模型,在SWE-bench验证后获得不到1分,而完整混合则在SWE-bench验证后提高3.0分,2.5分,在SWE-bench验证后获得6.6分,多语种验证后获得终端-Bench. 我们仍然保留着自然数据 大部分混合。 其好处超越了SWE-bench pass@1,在文件状态跟踪和跨文件模型(表5和5)中出现,并跨代理吊带的稳健性(§4.5),大部分痕迹的混合将相当于更长的SFT,这可能会伤害后来的RL列车可操作性(Liu等人,2026b;Kang等人,2025;Zhang等人,2026)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Scaling N-3.5 Lightning to 500B tokens
blocks.zh: 4.3 将N-3.5闪电放大至500B令牌

blocks.en: Our main N-3.5 Lightning experiment uses the long-context checkpoint N-3.5 Lightning-LC as the base model (§ 3.1 ). The blend has about 380B unique tokens (Table 1 ), enough to midtrain for 500B tokens while seeing each natural source about once. We apply identical full SFT to the base model and to midtrained checkpoints from 100B to 500B tokens (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的主要N-3.5闪电实验使用长条形检查点N-3.5闪电-LC作为基准模型(§3.1. 混合体有大约380B独有的代币(表1),足以在看到每个自然来源约一次的同时,进行500B代币的中试. 我们对基地模式和100B至500B令牌的中试检查站适用相同的SFT全文(表3)。

blocks.en: Midtraining improves every benchmark over the base model. After 500B tokens, pass@1 rises by 3.8 points on SWE-bench Verified, 7.0 on SWE-bench Multilingual, 3.5 on SWE-bench Pro, and 1.0 on Terminal-Bench, and pass@ k k rises on all four, by 2.3 to 4.7 points. Most of the SWE-bench Verified and Pro gain arrives by 100B tokens, SWE-bench Multilingual keeps improving up to 500B, and Terminal-Bench is noisier and peaks at 300B. Unlike Table 2 , these results start from N-3.5 Lightning-LC. After identical full SFT, its scores differ slightly from those of N-3.5 Lightning-8K, but stay within run-to-run variation. Midtraining also changes how the agent uses its context. Without midtraining, 4.1% of SWE-bench Pro rollouts fail by filling the 256K context window, compared with 0.6% after 500B tokens (Appendix E.1 ).
blocks.zh: 中级培训比基准模式改进了每个基准。 500B令牌之后,通过@1在SWE-bench Verifed上上升了3.8分,在SWE-bench 多语种上上升了7.0分,在SWE-bench Pro上上升了3.5分,在终端-Bench上上升了1.0分,并在所有四个上通过@k 上升了2.3分到4.7分. 大部分SWE-bench验证和Pro增益以100B令牌到达,SWE-bench多种语言不断改进,达到500B,Terminal-Bench是噪声,峰值300B. 与表2不同的是,这些结果起源于N-3.5闪电-LC. 在完全相同的SFT之后,它的分数与N-3.5闪电-8K略有不同,但保持在运行中的变化范围内. Midtraining也改变代理人如何使用其上下文. 没有中训,4.1%的SWE-bench Pro推出失败,通过填充256K上下文窗口,而500B令牌之后的0.6%(附录E.1 ).

blocks.en: The base-model post-trainability metrics show the same trend (Table 5 ). All four improve over the base model and keep improving from 100B to 500B tokens, reflecting the capabilities that the natural SWE data and traces add. On LoCoDiff, for example, the base model rebuilds no files exactly, while the midtrained model rebuilds 21.5% after 100B tokens and 26.8% after 500B. Most of this gain comes from the diff data, which raises exact match from about 1% to 30% in a controlled 10B-token comparison in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 基本模式的训练后衡量标准也显示出同样的趋势(表5)。 所有四个都比基模型有所改善,并不断从100B提高到500B令牌,反映了自然SWE数据和痕迹所增加的能力. 例如在LoCoDiff上,基础模型没有精确重建文件,而中训练模型在100B令牌后重建21.5%,500B后重建26.8%. 大部分收益来自diff数据,在表5中控制10B-token的比较中将精确匹配率从1%提高到30%左右.

blocks.en: Table 3: Midtraining scaling on N-3.5 Lightning-LC after identical full SFT. After 500B tokens, midtraining improves both pass@1 and pass@ k k on every benchmark, so it raises what the model can solve rather than only its reliability.
blocks.zh: 表3:相同全SFT后在N-3.5闪电-LC上缩放的中训. 在500B令牌之后,中训可以提高每个基准上的通过@1和通过@kk,从而提升模型所能解决的问题,而不仅仅是其可靠性.

blocks.en: Table 4: Base-model post-trainability metrics for N-3.5 Lightning-LC and its midtrained checkpoints from the scaling run. All metrics improve as midtraining scales.
blocks.zh: 表4:N-3.5闪电-LC及其自规模化运行起训练有素的检查站的训练后基准模型。 所有衡量标准都随着中等培训水平而改进。

blocks.en: Table 5: LoCoDiff on midtrained N-3.5 Lightning base models. The two 10B-token runs start from N-3.5 Lightning-8K and differ only in whether half of the blend is diff data. Diff data drives most of the LoCoDiff gain.
blocks.zh: 表5:中训N-3.5闪电基型上的LoCoDiff. 两个10B-token运行从N-3.5闪电-8K开始,仅在混音是否一半是diff数据上有所不同. Diff数据驱动 LoCoDiff 大部分增益.

blocks.en: 4.4 Scaling to N-3.5 Super
blocks.zh: 4.4 放大至N-3.5超级

blocks.en: We further apply the recipe to the larger N-3.5 Super to test how it scales with model size. We midtrain for 65B and 280B tokens with the blend in Figure 1 . As in the scaling run, we start from the long-context checkpoint and compare each midtrained model with the base model after identical short and full SFT (Table 6 ). The clearest gain is on DeepSWE ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , the hardest benchmark, whose long-horizon tasks are written from scratch. After full SFT, 280B tokens of midtraining raise it from 11.7 to 15.7, and after short SFT from 6.4 to 12.4. SWE-bench Verified also improves, from 72.9 to 74.3 after full SFT, and BrowseComp by 3 points after both short and full SFT. SWE-bench Multilingual and Pro do not improve. After full SFT they are 1.1 and 2.1 points below the base model, while after short SFT they are level with or slightly above it, so we do not read these differences as a consistent effect.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步将食谱应用到更大的N-3.5 Super来测试它如何用模型大小来缩放. 我们在65B和280B的中间训练 混合在图1中。 与缩放运行一样,我们从长装检查站开始,在相同的短装和全装SFT之后,将每个中训练模型与基准模型进行比较(表6)。 最明显的收获是在DeepSWE上(Huang et al., 2026),最难的基准,其长视距任务从头开始写. 在SFT完全完成后,280B的中训符号从11.7提高到15.7,在SFT短篇之后从6.4提高到12.4. SWE-bench Verifed也有所改进,在SFT完整后从72.9升至74.3,在SFT短后和完整后浏览Conp3分. SWE-bench 多种语言与Pro没有改进. 完全SFT之后,它们比基模低1.1和2.1分,而短SFT之后,它们与基模相同或略高于基模,因此我们不把这些差异看成是一贯的效果.

blocks.en: Table 6: N-3.5 Super after 65B and 280B midtraining tokens and identical short or full SFT (pass@1, %). Midtraining gives a large gain on DeepSWE, the hardest benchmark, and also improves SWE-bench Verified and BrowseComp.
blocks.zh: 表6:N-3.5 Super after 65B和280B 中训练符和相同的短或全SFT(通过@1,%). Midtraining在DeepSWE这个最难的基准上获得了很大的收益,同时也改进了SWE-bench Verifed和浏览Comp.

blocks.en: 4.5 Harness robustness
blocks.zh: 4.5 稳健性

blocks.en: Open models are used with many agent harnesses, not only the one their SFT data was built for, so harness robustness is a goal of our midtraining and the reason we draw traces from many scaffolds. Table 7 shows that midtraining improves pass@1 on every harness we tested, which makes both models more robust to the choice of harness, although large differences between harnesses remain. On N-3.5 Super after short SFT, the midtrained model is better on every harness, by 8.6 points on average on SWE-bench Verified and 6.8 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On N-3.5 Lightning-8K after full SFT, midtraining improves SWE-bench Verified on all six harnesses, by 11.6 points on average. Midtraining on the natural data alone already improves over the base model on four of the six harnesses, by up to 4.7 points, and adding the traces gives the largest gains. We did not train on traces from a single scaffold, so these results do not separate the effect of scaffold diversity from that of adding traces.
blocks.zh: 开放的模型被使用 有很多的代理吊带, 不仅是他们的SFT数据为它而建的, 因此,吊带坚固性是我们中途训练的一个目标, 也是我们从许多脚手架上提取痕迹的原因。 表7显示,中级培训改进了我们测试过的每条带子的传递@1,这使得两种模型在选择带子时都更加坚固,尽管带子之间的巨大差异依然存在. 在短SFT后的N-3.5 Super上,中训练的型号在每一个吊带上都比较好,在SWE-bench验证器上平均得分8.6分,在终端-Bench 2.1. 在N-3.5闪电-8K全SFT之后,中训改进了SWE-bench测试所有6个吊带,平均得分11.6分. 仅关于自然数据的中期培训就已经比六条绳索中的四条绳索的基础模型有所改善,最高可达4.7分,加起来的痕迹带来最大的收益。 我们没有从一个脚手架上训练痕迹,因此这些结果并没有将脚手架多样性的效果与添加痕迹的效果区分开来.

blocks.en: Table 7: Midtraining improves pass@1 on every agent harness we evaluated, for both models, with the largest gain on the harness where the base model is weakest (%).
blocks.zh: 表7:中级培训改进了我们评价的每一种剂管的传递@1,对这两种模型而言,在底模最弱的装置上收益最大(%)。

blocks.en: 5 Analysis and Ablations
blocks.zh: 5 分析和损坏

blocks.en: 5.1 Midtraining as a long-context stage
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 中训作为长篇小说阶段

blocks.en: Because midtraining trains at 256K, it also extends the model’s context. Table 8 compares the usual order, where N-3.5 Lightning-8K goes straight to the long-context stage, with a 100B-token N-3.5 Lightning midtraining run at 256K before a long-context stage. Midtraining alone brings N-3.5 Lightning-8K within about five points of the long-context base model on RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ) up to 128K, but trails by 14 points at 256K. After the long-context stage, the midtrained model beats the long-context base model at every length from 64K to 256K and stays within two points at shorter lengths. Midtraining thus does part of the work of the long-context stage, and this carries over to the final model. Appendix E.2 gives more results for N-3.5 Super.
blocks.zh: 由于256K的中训列车,它也扩展了车型的背景. 表8比较了通常的顺序,其中N-3.5闪电-8K直达长文本阶段,在长文本阶段之前,100B-token N-3.5闪电中试运行为256K. 仅Midtrain将N-3.5闪电-8K在RULAR(Hsieh et al., 2024)的长文本基模型的大约5个点内,最高可达128K,但小径在256K以14个点. 在长编剧阶段之后,中训型在每长64K至256K之间击败长编剧基型,并以较短的长度停留在两点之内. 因此,中期培训是长文阶段的一部分工作,这项工作将延续到最后模式。 附录E.2为N-3.5 Super提供了更多的结果.

blocks.en: Table 8: N-3.5 Lightning RULER scores up to 256K. Midtraining alone brings N-3.5 Lightning-8K close to N-3.5 Lightning-LC up to 128K, acting like a long-context stage.
blocks.zh: 表8:N-3.5闪电RULAR最高得分256K. 中训单是将N-3.5闪电-8K带近N-3.5闪电-LC,最高可达128K,表现得像一个长文舞台.

blocks.en: 5.2 Masking tool responses in traces
blocks.zh: 5.2 有痕迹的面具工具反应

blocks.en: Agent traces interleave the model’s own actions with tool responses, the outputs the environment returns after each tool call. Some recent work also trains on tool responses, so that the model learns to predict how the environment reacts, a form of world modeling ( FAIR CodeGen Team, 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: Agent 追踪该模型自己的动作与工具响应交互, 输出环境在每次工具调用后返回 。 最近的一些工作还训练工具响应,以便模型学会预测环境的反应,一种世界建模形式(FAIR CodeGen Team,2025年;Zeng等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Table 9: Tool-response masking. N-3.5 Lightning-8K midtrained for 100B tokens with and without tool responses in the loss, followed by identical SFT with an earlier version of our SFT recipe (SWE-bench Verified).
blocks.zh: 表9:工具反应面具。 N-3.5闪电-8K中试,用于100B令牌在丢失时有无工具响应,之后与之前版本的SFT配方(SWE-bench Verifed)完全相同.

blocks.en: We tested this with the setup of § 4.2 , midtraining N-3.5 Lightning-8K for 100B tokens with and without tool responses in the loss, followed by identical SFT with an earlier version of our SFT recipe. In our experiments, training on tool responses did not work out of the box and lowered SWE-bench Verified pass@1 by about 10 points (Table 9 ), so we train only on assistant turns, as in SFT. Tool responses are often long and noisy, such as file dumps, test logs, and error traces, and predicting them may take capacity away from learning the agent’s own actions.
blocks.zh: 我们用第4.2节的设定测试了这个, 中间训练N-3.5闪电-8K 对于100B的令牌, 在我们的实验中,关于工具响应的培训没有在盒子里起作用,并且将SWE-bench验证的传球@1降低了大约10分(表9),所以我们只在助理转弯时进行训练,例如SFT. 工具响应往往很长而且很吵,例如文件堆放、测试日志和错误痕迹,并且预测它们可能会剥夺学习代理商自身行为的能力。

blocks.en: 5.3 Pretraining replay and learning rate
blocks.zh: 5.3 培训前再演和学习率

blocks.en: Replay keeps the model close to its pretraining distribution, so that midtraining shifts the data distribution gradually rather than abruptly. We started from 20% replay as a reasonable default, with the goal of no regression on general-capability benchmarks. Table 11 shows that N-3.5 Super does not regress through 65B tokens, with every benchmark group within 1.2 points of the starting checkpoint. We also tried 40% replay, which gave no clear benefit over 20%, so we kept 20%.
blocks.zh: 重播使模型接近其预训分布,因此中训逐渐而不是突然改变数据分布. 我们从20%开始作为合理的默认, 目标不退步于一般能力基准。 表11显示,N-3.5Super不通过65B令牌倒退,每个基准组都在起始检查站的1.2点之内. 我们还尝试了40%的重播,这并没有给20%以上的明显利益,所以我们保留了20%.

blocks.en: Table 10: N-3.5 Super pretraining benchmarks before and after midtraining with 20% replay.
blocks.zh: 表10: N-3.5 中训前后超级预训基准,重播20%.

blocks.en: Table 11: N-3.5 Lightning-8K after 100B midtraining tokens at three learning rates.
blocks.zh: 表11:100B中训练符号后以三种学习速率的N-3.5闪电-8K.

blocks.en: The learning rate also affects general capabilities. Pretraining ends with a small, decayed learning rate, and midtraining needs a higher one to learn the new data. In our early runs, midtraining at 1e-5 gave smaller gains after SFT than higher rates did. Raising the rate too far, however, hurts general capabilities even with replay. Table 11 compares a constant 1e-5 with warming up to 3e-5 or 5e-5. Both higher rates lower general capabilities, most clearly MATH-500, which falls from 79.7 to 61.7 at 5e-5. We therefore recommend a moderate increase and checking general-capability benchmarks while tuning it.
blocks.zh: 学习率也影响到一般能力。 预训以小的衰败的学习率结束,中训需要更高一个来学习新数据. 在我们早期的训练中,中训在SFT之后得到的收益比高。 然而,即使通过重播,提高率也会损害一般能力。 表11比较了常数1e-5和升温到3e-5或5e-5。 这两种较高的比率都较低,最明显的是MATH-500,在5e-5时从79.7降至61.7。 因此,我们建议适度增加并检查一般能力基准,同时加以调整。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented an open midtraining recipe for agentic coding, with full details of how each data source is built, filtered, and weighted and how the models are trained. After identical SFT, the recipe gives clear gains as midtraining scales to 500B tokens on N-3.5 Lightning, and it carries over to the larger N-3.5 Super, where it raises DeepSWE, the hardest benchmark we evaluate, from 11.7 to 15.7 and also improves SWE-bench Verified and BrowseComp. On both models, midtraining improves results on every agent harness we tested. Our experiments show that agentic traces are essential, since natural software-engineering data alone gives much smaller gains after SFT, and that a short SFT run gives a more direct post-training signal than base-model post-trainability metrics, which remain useful to track. Midtraining at 256K also works as an intermediate long-context stage, and we explain our other modeling choices, such as tool-response masking and pretraining replay.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一种用于代理编码的开放式中期培训方法,其中详细介绍了每个数据来源的构建、过滤和加权方式,以及模型的培训方式。 在同样的SFT之后,食谱在N-3.5闪电上给500B令牌带来明显的增益,并传递到更大的N-3.5超级,将我们评价最难的基准DeepSWE从11.7提高到15.7,还改进了SWE-bench验证和浏览Comp. 在两种模式上,中训能改善我们测试过的每条毒剂的利用效果. 我们的实验表明,代理跟踪是不可或缺的,因为仅靠自然软件工程数据就能在SFT之后产生更小的收益,而短时间的SFT运行能提供更直接的训练后信号,而不是基建型的训练后测量标准,它们仍然对追踪有用. 256K的中训也作为中间长写阶段发挥作用,我们解释我们的其他模型选择,如工具响应面具和预训重播.

blocks.en: Agentic benchmarks are noisy, and each comparison is a single run, so differences of one or two points, especially on Terminal-Bench, may come from run-to-run variation. We did not compare against spending the same tokens on longer pretraining or SFT, since midtraining adds a separate stage that complements SFT rather than replacing it. We tested the recipe only on Nemotron models, not on other model families, and mainly on agentic coding. Our SFT evaluations use an agentic-focused SFT blend rather than a full general-purpose post-training blend. Our RL results are also limited, since clear RL gains on top of a strong SFT checkpoint were difficult to get at the N-3.5 Lightning scale and RL was too compute intensive at the N-3.5 Super scale, so we report only a short, single-seed run on N-3.5 Lightning-8K (Appendix D ). For future work, since traces drove most of the gains, we plan to scale trace data with more diversity, and we have already expanded our trace corpus to about 90B tokens. We also plan to extend the agentic data to more capabilities and to move more post-training data, such as reasoning and chat data, into midtraining.
blocks.zh: 代理基准很吵,每次比较都是单跑,因此一两个点的差异,特别是在终端-奔驰上,可能来自运行中的变化. 我们没有与在较长的预训或SFT上花费同样的费用相比较,因为中训增加了一个单独的阶段,补充了SFT,而不是取代它. 我们只测试了尼莫特龙模型, 而不是其他模型家庭, 并且主要测试了代理编码。 我们的SFT评价采用以药剂为重点的SFT混合物,而不是训练后完全通用的混合物. 我们的RL结果也很有限,因为一个强大的SFT检查点之上的清晰的RL增益在N-3.5闪电级上难以获得,而RL在N-3.5超大级上计算过于密集,因此我们只报告在N-3.5闪电-8K(Appendix D.)上一个短而单一的种子运行. 对于今后的工作来说,由于痕迹驱动了大部分成果,我们计划以更多的多样性来放大痕量数据,我们已经把我们的痕量指数扩大到大约90B个征兆。 我们还计划将代理数据扩大到更多的能力,并将更多的培训后数据,如推理和聊天数据,转入中级培训。

blocks.en: A.1 Issue–PR
blocks.zh: A.1 问题-PR

blocks.en: For PRs linked to an issue, an LLM judge checks whether the issue and the PR match. The judge reads the full issue and PR text, the final patch, and the paths of the changed files, and labels each pair as clean or assigns one of seven failure modes, namely a revert, an incidental issue link, a wrong issue reference, a partial fix, an issue with no clear action, an underspecified issue, or a PR that does much more than the issue asks. We keep clean pairs and remove pairs that cannot be fixed. We repair the others by linking the PR to the correct issue, narrowing its scope, keeping it as a PR-only example, or splitting it from unrelated changes. For PRs without a linked issue, we remove those that change only README files or three lines or fewer.
blocks.zh: 对于与某一问题相关的公关,LLM法官负责检查该问题与公关是否相符. 法官阅读了完整的问题和公关文本,最终补丁,以及更改文件的路径,并给每对文件贴上干净的标签或指定了七个失败模式中的一个,即回归,附带问题链接,错误的问题引用,部分解决,没有明确行动的问题,不精确的问题,或者比问题要求的多得多的公关. 我们保持干净的对并去除无法固定的对. 我们通过将公关与正确问题联系起来、缩小其范围、将其作为仅限公关的例子或将其从无关的变化中分离出来来修复其他问题。 对于没有关联问题的PR,我们删除那些只更改README文件或三行或更少的.

blocks.en: A.2 Repositories
blocks.zh: A.2 仓库

blocks.en: The repository data starts from the code repositories in the Nemotron 3 pretraining corpus ( NVIDIA, 2025 ) , a deduplicated collection of public repositories with permissive licenses, and covers 14 languages (Table 12 ).
blocks.zh: 储存库数据从Nemotron 3预训书(NVIDIA,2025年)的编码储存库开始,这是一份带有许可许可证的公共储存库的破译汇编,涵盖14种语言(表12)。

blocks.en: For each language, we parse the references that link one file to another, such as imports in Python, includes in C and C++, and module paths in Go. A repository’s connected fraction is the share of its code files that import another file in the repository, and we keep repositories where this share is at least 20%. For Ruby we lower the threshold to 10%, because Rails autoloading hides most references from static parsing. We exclude languages with little cross-file structure that parsing can recover, such as Shell, R, and Swift, as well as markup and configuration languages.
blocks.zh: 对于每种语言,我们解析将一个文件与另一个文件链接起来的引用,如Python中的导入,包括C和C++,以及Go中的模块路径. 一个寄存器的连接分数是其代码文件在寄存器中导入另一个文件的份额,我们保留该共享至少20%的寄存器。 对Ruby来说,我们把门槛降低到10%,因为Rails自动加载隐藏了大部分来自静态解析的引用. 我们排除了很少交叉文件结构的解析可以恢复的语言,如壳牌,R,和斯威夫特,以及标记和配置语言.

blocks.en: The code files follow the README in depth-first order over the import graph, so the files of each connected component stay together and each file sits near the files it imports. Each file starts with a header that gives the repository name and file path, and the header is masked from the loss.
blocks.zh: 代码文件在导入图上以深度第一顺序跟随README,因此每个连接组件的文件都保持在一起,每个文件坐落在它导入的文件附近. 每个文件都以一个给寄存器名称和文件路径的头条开头,头条被蒙住丢失的阴影.

blocks.en: We deduplicate files by path within each repository and drop Python 2 code, removing the whole repository when most of it is Python 2. We drop repositories that contain server-side secrets, such as cloud or API keys, and redact client-side keys, which are common in mobile and web projects. We also strip license and auto-generated headers, and drop repositories above 2M tokens or those that lose most of their files in deduplication. To avoid contamination, we remove SWE-bench repositories and their forks, as well as files that contain HumanEval, MBPP, or LiveCodeBench ( Jain et al., 2025 ) solutions.
blocks.zh: 我们在每个寄存器内部通过路径复制文件,并丢弃Python 2代码,当大部分是Python 2时删除整个寄存器. 我们放下包含服务器侧密钥的寄存器,如云或API密钥,以及编辑客户端侧密钥,这在移动和网络项目中很常见. 我们还脱除许可证和自动生成头条,并将寄存器放在2M令牌上方,或那些在折叠中丢失大部分文件的人。 为了避免污染,我们移除了SWE-bench寄存器及其叉子,以及包含HumanEval, MBPP,或LiveCode Bench(Jain等人,2025年)解决方案的文件.

blocks.en: Multi-file edits come from merged pull requests in the Issue–PR corpus, with the full patch and every changed file before the change. In multi-file edits, the loss covers the original files, the diffs, and the changed lines of the new files with two lines of context. In code-evolution documents, it covers the commit messages, diffs, and final state, and license blocks are masked in both. blocks.en: Raw logs come from the full LogHub archives (BGL, Thunderbird, HPC, HDFS, Spark, and Windows). We cut them into non-overlapping windows of 120 context lines followed by 16 target lines. We deduplicate HDFS logs after masking block identifiers, hosts, and timestamps. No single archive is more than 28% of this source. Supercomputer logs are at least 30%, and CI/CD logs from GHALogs run logs and workflow-file histories are at least 12%. We check every source against a license registry and exclude sources with unknown licenses. We also build 632 diagnosis examples. Each centers a window of HPC logs on a warning, error, or critical event, and a frontier model writes the diagnosis from the window and from findings that simple rules extract. We redact secrets and mask timestamps, hostnames, hashes, and repeated boilerplate from the loss.

blocks.en: C.2 Base-model post-trainability metrics
blocks.zh: C.2 培训后基准模型衡量标准

blocks.en: We track four base-model post-trainability metrics during midtraining. • LoCoDiff ( Mentat AI Team (2025), AbanteAI ) gives the model the full git history of a file and asks it to write the file’s final state. We use all 198 cases, zero-shot with greedy decoding and a 16K-token generation budget, which covers the longest reference file (11.7K tokens). Exact match is the share of files reproduced byte for byte, and normalized edit distance is capped at 1.2 per case. Greedy decoding still varies slightly across runs because inference is not bit-exact, so we average both over 3 runs. • RepoBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) measures next-line code completion that requires context from other files in the repository. We report edit similarity in the cross-file-first setting, with greedy decoding. • Repository bits-per-byte follows Composer 2 ( Cursor Research, 2026 ) . We concatenate the files of held-out repositories and compute bits-per-byte over long windows. Our version puts the README first, orders files by dependency, keeps the file tree across windows, and does not score file headers. • Trace bits-per-byte is measured on the assistant turns of held-out agent traces, following the decisive-action bits-per-byte of Yu et al. (2026) . The version in Table 5 scores only the decisive turns of DeepSWE traces, the turns that most affect the outcome, and masks tool-call formatting, which otherwise dominates the score.

blocks.en: Appendix D Persistence of gains through reinforcement learning
blocks.zh: 附录D 通过强化学习实现收益的持久性

blocks.en: As a preliminary check on whether midtraining gains persist under RL, we run an identical short stage of RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR), 20 GRPO steps ( Shao et al., 2024 ) over 14 verifiable environments (Appendix D.2 ), from N-3.5 Lightning-8K and its midtrained checkpoint after full SFT. Twenty steps is too short to measure an RL gain, so we only ask whether the midtrained model’s advantage survives the start of RL.
blocks.zh: 为了初步检查在RL下是否持续取得中度训练成果,我们在14个可核查的环境(附录D.2)上,从N-3.5闪电-8K及其经过全面SFT后经过中度训练的检查站,运行了同样短期的RL,可核查奖励(RLVR),20个GRPO步骤(Shao等人,2024年). 20个步骤太短,无法衡量RL的增益,所以我们只问中训练模式的优势是否在RL的开始后存活下来.

blocks.en: D.2 Setup and training signals
blocks.zh: D.2 设置和培训信号

blocks.en:
The RLVR prompt blend is drawn from 14 verifiable environments (tool use,
code generation, SWE and search pivots, instruction following, reasoning,
and formatting). We reward-profile a seed blend against both checkpoints
and keep only prompts with mixed rewards, meaning that for each checkpoint
some but not all of its sampled rollouts succeed, so every prompt is
neither trivial nor unsolvable for either model. Training is GRPO with a
leave-one-out baseline and no reference-policy KL penalty, 256 prompts × \times 16 generations per step, a 32K-token output cap within a 131K
context, a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} with 10 warmup steps, and 20
optimizer updates. The two runs differ only in their starting checkpoint;

blocks.en: E.1 Context-limit failures
blocks.zh: E.1 上下文限制失败

blocks.en: Rollouts that fill the 256K context window count as failures. Under the same harness and settings, they are much more common without midtraining (Table 19 ), especially on SWE-bench Pro. On SWE-bench Verified, rollouts also hit the 200-turn cap 11 times without midtraining and once after 500B tokens. Midtraining appears to make the agent more economical with its context and turns, not only more accurate.

blocks.en: E.2 Long-context results at 1M
blocks.zh: E.2 1M的长文本结果

blocks.en: To keep evaluation simple, our N-3.5 Super runs start midtraining from the 1M long-context checkpoint (§ 3.1 ). Midtraining then trains at 256K, so RULER at 1M naturally drops, from 79.9 to 33.0 after 25B tokens. A short long-context stage of about 9B tokens, on long-context data only, brings it back to 81.0, above the starting checkpoint, and the 65B N-3.5 Super checkpoint evaluated in § 4.4 includes this short stage, while the 280B checkpoint goes straight to SFT. This drop is a side effect of our evaluation setup. In a mature pipeline, midtraining would come before the final long-context stage, as in § 5.1 .
blocks.zh: 为了保持评价简单,我们的N-3.5超级跑从1M长文检查点(§3.1)开始中训. 中训然后在256K进行列车,因此1M的RULAR自然下降,从25B令牌后的79.9降至33.0. 短长的9B令牌阶段,仅以长长的令牌数据为主,使其在起始检查站上方恢复到81.0,在§4.4中评价的65B N-3.5超级检查站包括这一短暂阶段,而280B检查站则直接前往SFT. 这一下降是我们评估设置的副作用。 在成熟的管道中,中期培训将像第5.1节那样在最后的长文阶段之前进行。
